page.overview:
What is Hell and Back?

Hell and Back is the third song off of Metallica's 2011 EP, Beyond Magnetic, which consists of songs that were written during the Death Magnetic recording sessions but didn't make the final cut onto the album. The song was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, Kirk Hammett, and Robert Trujillo.

There's nowhere else I can run to She's wretched but she comforts me

After everyone goes home She's always there for me

When the sun goes hellbound And the moon does resurrect the night I'll hide within her Not much good has come out of the light
